data.name: Glad
data.gender_notes: Glad is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘glæd’, meaning ‘happy’ or ‘joyful’. This name evokes feelings of pleasure and contentment. In Christianity, the name Glad is associated with the joy and happiness found in the love of God and the blessings of His grace. The name Glad carries the meaning “Happy, joyful, pleasing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Glad usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of joy and happiness found in the love of God.
data.etymology: Glad belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Happy, joyful, pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Glad total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: גלאד
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גלאד מקורו בשפה העברית ומשמעותו שמח, ששון, גיל. הוא קשור למושגים של שמחה וגילוי, ויכול לשמש כביטוי לשמחה ולששון בקרב המאמינים.

in_greek.name: Γλαδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Γλαδ προέρχεται από τὴν ἑβραϊκὴ γλώσσα καὶ σημαίνει χαρά, εὐφροσύνη. Στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, τὸ πνεῦμα τῆς χαράς καὶ τῆς εὐφροσύνης εἶναι στενά συνδεδεμένο μὲ τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπη.

in_latin.name: Glad
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Glad ex Hebraeo origine venit et gaudium, laetitiam significat. In primitiva Ecclesia, nomen hoc potuit esse symbolum spei et felicitatis quae ex fide christiana oritur.

in_english.name: Glad

The name Glad is also a reminder of the joy and blessings that come from following God's will and living a life that is pleasing to Him.
